name: What if the developer makes changes to the property after I sign the contract?

mainEntity.name: What if the developer makes changes to the property after I sign the contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most pre-construction contracts include clauses allowing developers to make certain changes to the plans, materials, or finishes, particularly if these changes are minor or necessitated by supply issues or building code updates. Your contract guidance will focus on understanding the scope of these allowable changes and identifying your rights should the modifications be significant or materially affect the value or quality of your property. We help clarify the specific conditions under which a developer can modify plans and your options, such as receiving compensation or even withdrawing from the agreement, ensuring you understand your recourse during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Developer changes after signing are often allowed by contract for minor issues. Guidance helps clarify your rights and options if significant modifications occur, such as compensation or contract withdrawal.
